card.name: Space before greater/less-than thresholds
card.fires_on: The space or punctuation just before a comparison symbol such as >, <, or ≥ that introduces a numeric cutoff. It appears in lab values, QTc limits, and adverse-reaction frequency thresholds.

modes.label: Before > or < cutoff
modes.description: A space right before a greater-than or less-than sign that begins a numeric limit.
modes.example: QTc prolongation of<< >>>500 msec was higher in V

modes.label: Range or change threshold
modes.description: A space, comma, or ≥ sign in ranges and decline or decrease thresholds before the next number.
modes.example: or a decline from baseline of 10% to<< <>> 50%, was 10
